automation_evidence.quote: Using LLMs (DeepSeek V3 (DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024), Qwen 2.5 72B (Qwen et al., 2025) Llama 3.3 70B (Grattafiori et al., 2024)), we extract stock recommendations and risk assessment

metric_evidence.quote: These preliminary results in figure 1 with Qwen 2.5 show that integrating LLM stock recommendations consistently improves PPO in terms of cumulative returns.

evidence.quote: For PPO-DeepSeek, stronger LLM infusion mostly degrades performance, even for tiny (0.1%) perturbations.

practical_problems.note: Varies the strength of the news-derived LLM signal from 10% to 0.1% against price-only PPO; the effect is mostly negative for PPO.

evidence.quote: For CPPO-DeepSeek, stronger LLM infusion improves performance

practical_problems.note: Risk-score modulation of CVaR-PPO returns evaluated with CVaR, Information Ratio and Rachev Ratio across infusion strengths.

summary: News-derived LLM recommendation and risk scores scale RL trading actions and CVaR returns; backtests show mixed gains, helping CPPO with stronger infusion but mostly hurting PPO.
